help_t0_body:
1. Open the Discord app on your PC (not the browser version).

2. At the top of the window, choose your console: Nintendo Switch or Switch 2.

3. Double-click the game you're playing.

That's it: your Discord profile now shows the game, the console and your play time.

To stop, click “Stop” (or close the app). You can also write a custom message (for example “Level 12”) in the main window.
help_t1_body:
Check these points, in order:

1. Use the Discord app installed on your PC, not the website in a browser.

2. In Discord, go to Settings > Activity Privacy and turn on activity sharing (“Share my detected activity”).

3. Look at your profile from another account, or ask a friend: Discord doesn't always show your own activity the way others see it (the button, for example, is never shown to you).

4. If the cover stays a “?”, wait a few seconds, then click “Stop” and “Show on Discord” again.

5. Still nothing? Fully close Discord (right-click its icon near the clock, then “Quit”), reopen it and try again.
help_t2_title: Add a game with its cover
help_t2_body:
1. Click “+ Add a game”.

2. Type the game name: it's what appears in big letters on your profile.

3. For the cover, find the game's image on Google Images, right-click it, then “Copy image address”, and paste the link into the “Cover” field.

Tips:
• The link must start with https:// and lead directly to an image (.png, .jpg).
• Images from Wikipedia (upload.wikimedia.org) or SteamGridDB work very well.
• If an image doesn't show up, try another link.
• Without a cover, a default image is shown: the game name stays correct.

You can change the cover later: right-click the game > “Change cover…”.
help_t3_body:
Click “Customize my presence” at the bottom of the main window (or Options > Customize my presence). Every setting has an explanation and a preview shows the result live.

You can show or hide:
• the play timer,
• the console name under the game,
• the small Switch / Switch 2 badge on the cover,
• the “{button}” button.

You can also write a custom message in the main window. Changes apply immediately if a game is already showing.
help_t4_title: My game isn't in the list
help_t4_body:
Two options:

• Add it yourself with “+ Add a game” (see “Add a game with its cover”).

• Ask for it to be added: I'll add it with its official cover and everyone will get it the next time the app starts (or via Options > Refresh game list).
help_t5_body:
On first launch, Windows may show “Windows protected your PC” or “Unknown publisher”. That's normal: the app isn't digitally signed (a signature costs money).

Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

The source code is public on GitHub: you can check it, or build the app yourself. If your antivirus blocks it by mistake, add it as an exception.
help_t6_body:
A bug, an idea, a game to add? Write to me!

• Discord: {discord}
• GitHub: open an issue (you need a GitHub account, it's free).

For a bug, tell me what you were doing, the error message if any, and the app version ({version}).
help_copied: Username “{discord}” copied. Paste it in Discord's search.
